name: trainsfyi
description: Find rail stations, networks, train positions, trip stops and current departures using the TrainsFYI API.

interface.longDescription: Find rail stations and operators, look up a train’s currently available position, view its trip stops, and check up to five current station departures. Search can include a city, province, country or operator. Use Trains.fyi to explore railway services and answer questions about available train information. Coverage and freshness vary by network. Positions may be vehicle-sourced or estimated, and estimates are identified accordingly. Timetables do not confirm service on a particular date; a missing position does not mean a train is cancelled. Ticket booking, future-date last-train journey planning and historical train positions are not supported.
defaultPrompt: Find the St Marys Ontario station.
What are the next five GO Transit departures from Toronto Union Station?

positive.description: Resolve a station with province context
positive.prompt: Find the St Marys Ontario station.
positive.expected_behavior: The returned station is St. Marys on VIA Rail in Ontario, Canada. Preserve the Ontario constraint; do not substitute Sydney, Australia.

positive.prompt: Find the GO Transit rail network.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify GO Transit and its returned network slug. Do not guess a slug or confuse it with another operator.

positive.description: Locate a named train with honest freshness
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve VIA Rail, then look up train 641. Report an available position with source and freshness, identifying estimates. If no position is available, say so without claiming cancellation; timetable candidates do not prove service today.

positive.prompt: Find VIA train 641 and show its stops.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a trip_id returned by find_train, never the train number as a trip_id. Preserve the selected service_date when available. Show stop names and local railway times; distinguish schedule, realtime and estimated progress. If no trip is returned, state that stops are unavailable.

positive.description: Get current departures for a particular operator
positive.prompt: What are the next five GO Transit departures from Toronto Union Station?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Toronto Union with GO Transit context, then use the returned GO member station_id. Show up to five current departures with destination, local time and available platform/status. Report missing data honestly; never use the TTC member or invent departures.

negative.description: Ticket purchase is outside this connector
negative.prompt: Using Trains.fyi, buy me a VIA ticket from Toronto to Ottawa.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that ticket purchase is not supported. Do not claim to reserve, buy or charge anything.

negative.description: Future last-train planning is not exposed
negative.prompt: Using Trains.fyi, when is the last GO train from Toronto to Barrie tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this connector cannot answer a future-date last-train planning query. Do not present the current departure board as tomorrow’s service.

negative.prompt: Using Trains.fyi, where exactly was VIA train 641 yesterday at noon?
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that historical train positions are unavailable through this connector. Do not substitute the current position or timetable for historical observation.

publication.release_notes: Clarify the train-information listing description and its supported capabilities.
